title: FEUE announcement of a first plantón outside Universidad Central
notes: El Mercurio’s 28 February account uses future tense to say FEUE would hold its first plantón at noon outside Universidad Central over free university entry and the proposed higher-education law reform (S002 lines 51, 56–58); it does not report completion or attendance. A later El Comercio page reports Frente Popular actions on 1 March and says FEUE joined plantones in Quito (S003 lines 38–40), which is March evidence and does not confirm that the announced February 28 gathering occurred. Retain the occurrence question in G002; do not treat an announcement as an event.
